changelog:
⚡ 概览接口降载：/admin/api/overview 的两条重聚合（7 天缓存命中统计 SUM 与日趋势 GROUP BY）加 10 秒进程内 TTL 缓存，实时字段（请求/成功数、token、credits、RPM、TPM、并发、账号/卡密计数）不缓存、保持秒级新鲜；管理页轮询分级——概览与日志保持约 1 秒，账号与卡密两个 tab 放宽到约 10 秒（其数据由后端 5 分钟周期刷新，秒级轮询纯属浪费），页面恢复可见时立即刷新一次。
📈 TPM 平滑：实时 TPM 从 60 秒窗口改为 300 秒 token 环形窗口并 ÷5 归一化为每分钟，单次大请求完成不再表现为 60 秒方波，曲线随完成平滑上升、无流量时缓慢回落（RPM 口径不变）。
⚡ Overview load relief: the two heavy /admin/api/overview aggregations (7-day prompt-cache SUM and daily GROUP BY trend) are now served from a 10s in-process TTL cache, while realtime fields (request/success counts, tokens, credits, RPM, TPM, concurrency, account/key counts) stay uncached and second-fresh; admin polling is tiered — overview and logs keep ~1s, accounts and keys relax to ~10s (their data only moves on the backend's 5-minute refresh), with an immediate refresh on tab visibility regain.
📈 TPM smoothing: realtime TPM switches from a 60s window to a 300s token ring normalized to per-minute (÷5), so one large completed request no longer shows up as a 60-second square wave — the curve rises smoothly on completions and decays gently when traffic stops (RPM is unchanged).
